text: RepoScope
The Graph Operating System for AI Coding Agents & Engineering Teams
One unified AST code graph serving four ingress surfaces: the Interactive Web Canvas, the Headless CLI, the Native VS Code Extension, and the 9-Agent Universal MCP Harness.

• v2.8.0 Unified Production Release   • 100% Zero-Upload Local Privacy
• 9-Agent MCP Configurator   • 6-Engine Contextual Security Suite   • Symbol-Level PR Contract Safety
github.com/adityapatel5912/RepoScope  •  open-vsx.org/extension/adityapatel5912/reposcope
Slide 01: Executive Title and Vision. RepoScope unifies AST code graphs across human IDEs and 9 AI agent ecosystems.
01 • THE PROBLEM   •   REPOSCOPE v2.8
Every Repository is a Living Graph. We Still Read It as a Pile of Files.
Both human engineers and AI coding agents suffer when architectural truth lives in scattered, flat directories.

The Agent Context Tax (92% Waste)
• Blind Directory Scanning: LLMs exhaust precious context tokens reading irrelevant files.
• Severe Hallucination Rate: Without verified AST coordinates, agents invent broken APIs.
• Divergent Mental Models: Agents miss module boundaries, causing architectural drift.

Invisible Multi-Hop Blast Radius
• Human Grep Guesswork: Developers guess downstream impact before merging PRs.
• Silent Contract Breaks: Renaming a parameter breaks callers 3 hops away.
• Missing Test Coverage: PRs modify high-centrality files without updating tests.

Tribal Onboarding & Knowledge Loss
• Months to Full Productivity: New hires spend weeks orienting without a topological map.
• Architectural Drift: System structure lives in senior heads; docs rot quickly.
• Zero Shared Truth: No single foundation unifies IDEs, CLI, and AI agents.
Slide 02: Core problem statement covering context waste, blast radius blindspots, and tribal onboarding.
02 • ARCHITECTURE   •   REPOSCOPE v2.8
One In-Place Code Graph. Four Synchronized Ingress Surfaces.
Every surface reads .reposcope/graph.json so human developers and AI coding agents quote identical answers.

1. Multi-Language AST Parser
• Tree-sitter Grammars: High-speed parsing for Python, TypeScript, TSX, JS, Go, Rust.
• Typed Entity Extraction: Exact line coordinates for classes, functions, and routes.
• Directed Graph: Imports, calls, inheritance, containment, and taint propagation.

2. Zero-Upload Local Engine
• Localhost Privacy: reposcope run . indexes directly in place (127.0.0.1:4100).
• SQLite & JSON Store: Instant sub-second warm restarts with persistent graph store.
• Browser WASM Engine: Tree-sitter WASM via File System Access API without installation.

3. Four Synchronized Surfaces
• Interactive Web Canvas: React Flow + D3 graph with layer badges and inspection drawers.
• Headless CLI Tooling: Terminal CLI with CI/CD exit codes and JSON output.
• Universal MCP & VS Code: 8-tool MCP server for agents + live status bar risk in IDE.
Slide 03: Architecture overview detailing Tree-sitter parsing, zero-upload privacy, and four ingress surfaces.
03 • VISUAL NAVIGATION   •   REPOSCOPE v2.8
Read the Macro Architecture Before Reading Individual Files.
Switch seamlessly between React Flow architectural layers and D3 hierarchical semantic mindmaps.

Connectivity Pyramid & Layers
• Deterministic Layering: Root → Backbone → Core → Services → UI → Config → Docs.
• Layer Badges: Visual role badges (Entrypoint, Core, Route, Utility, Adapter).
• Directory Grouping: Toggle boundary boxes to inspect cross-module coupling.

D3 Semantic MindMap V2
• Dual Layouts: Left-to-Right (LR) tree flow and Top-to-Bottom (TB) hierarchy.
• Interactive Folding: Collapse or expand subtrees smoothly with SVG animations.
• Lightweight Performance: Pure SVG DOM rendering ensures responsive interactions.

Real-Time Node Inspector
• PageRank Hubs: Mathematical importance and coupling degree of every module.
• Direct Callers: Side drawer displaying upstream dependents and exported symbols.
• IDE Deep-Linking: Click any symbol to trigger reposcope://open directly into IDE.
Slide 04: Visual navigation via React Flow pyramid layers and D3 MindMap V2.
04 • AI AGENT ORCHESTRATION   •   REPOSCOPE v2.8
The Same Graph, Available to 9 Major Coding Agent Ecosystems.
Standardizing agent repository intelligence across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, and Windsurf.

Supported Agent Ecosystems
• Claude Code & OpenCode: Full stdio and Streamable HTTP support for Anthropic CLI.
• Cursor & Codex: Integration via .cursor/mcp.json and .codecompanion.json.
• Gemini, Copilot, Roo, Cline: Universal configuration generator applies tailored JSON.

8 High-Performance MCP Tools
• get_architecture_overview: Module boundaries, rules, entrypoints, and tech stack.
• calculate_blast_radius: Simulates 3-hop downstream impact before code refactoring.
• get_repo_map & get_hotspots: PageRank symbol hierarchy and Git churn heatmaps.

Dual Protocol & Safe Configurator
• Dual Transport: Local stdio pipe or persistent Streamable HTTP (port 8000).
• Eliminates SSE Dropouts: Streamable HTTP avoids Server-Sent Event timeouts.
• One-Click Dialog: Interactive modal allows developers to preview and apply configs.
Slide 05: 9-Agent MCP Harness covering tools, dual transport, and one-click configurator.
05 • CHANGE SAFETY   •   REPOSCOPE v2.8
Predict Change Blast Radius and Catch PR Contract Breaks.
Stop guessing if a refactor breaks downstream callers. Simulate multi-hop impact before opening a PR.

Multi-Hop Blast Simulator
• 3-Hop Tracing: Direct callers (Hop 1), indirect dependents (Hop 2), API bounds (Hop 3).
• 15-Point Risk Scoring: Risk calculation weighing centrality and critical paths.
• Risk Badges: Visual Critical (8/10), High (7/10), and Moderate badges warn of breaks.

Symbol-Level PR Analyzer
• Zero File Caps: Analyzes complete git diffs across any number of changed files.
• Contract Breaks: Pinpoints renamed parameters, modified returns, altered routes.
• Remediation Hints: Suggests exact downstream call-sites requiring updates.

Test Coverage Gap Alerts
• Uncovered Dependent Alerts: Cross-references affected nodes against test graph.
• GitHub CI/CD Bot: CLI generates rich Markdown/Mermaid impact comments on PRs.
• Pre-Commit Defense: Run reposcope blast locally before pushing to CI.
Slide 06: Multi-hop blast simulator and symbol-level PR contract break analyzer.
06 • SECURITY INTELLIGENCE   •   REPOSCOPE v2.8
Graph-Contextual Security: From Input Taint to Dangerous Sinks.
Six specialized vulnerability engines paired with automated AST syntax patch generation.

1. AST Taint Flow & Injections
• Source-to-Sink Tracing: Traces request.args through functions directly into sinks.
• Dangerous Sinks: Flags raw SQL execution, command injection, and unsafe evals.
• Contextual Trace Tree: Visual path from HTTP entry to database execution.

2. Secrets, CVEs & Config Drift
• Zero False-Positive Secrets: Detects API keys, JWT tokens, and leaked .env files.
• Graph-Aware CVEs: Maps dependency advisories to actual AST call-sites.
• Auth Bypass: Flags unauthenticated administrative endpoints and CORS drift.

3. Automated AST Patching
• Syntax Patch Viewer: Generates verified, syntactically correct AST replacements.
• Parameterized Queries: Transforms concatenated SQL into safe parameterized calls.
• One-Click CLI Fix: Run reposcope security --fix to apply patches to working tree.
Slide 07: 6-engine security suite covering taint flow, secrets, CVEs, and AST patch generation.
07 • DEVELOPER ONBOARDING   •   REPOSCOPE v2.8
Turn Complex Codebases into Structured, Topological Learning Paths.
Kahn DAG curriculum tiers and interactive guided tours replace scattered wiki pages and tribal meetings.

Topological Curriculum (Kahn DAG)
• Tier L1 (Core Foundations): Zero-dependency base utilities, models, and schemas.
• Tier L2 (Domain Services): Business logic engines and repository data pipelines.
• Tier L3 (APIs & Routes): HTTP controllers, REST routes, and auth middleware.
• Tier L4 (Integrations & UI): Frontend views, external APIs, and CLI commands.

Interactive Architectural Katas
• 'Why It Matters' Notes: Human-readable architectural role summaries.
• Checkpoint Quizzes: Interactive challenges test understanding of data flows.
• Canvas Highlighting: Selecting tiers illuminates the path on the graph.

4 Deterministic CodeTours
• System Overview Tour: 7-step orientation guiding developers through entrypoints.
• Security & Auth Track: Follows request authentication to permission checks.
• Request Lifecycle: Traces HTTP requests from routing to database commit.
• VS Code .tour Export: Exports guided tracks to standard .tour files.
Slide 08: Topological student onboarding (Kahn DAG) and deterministic CodeTours.
08 • PROMPT ENGINEERING   •   REPOSCOPE v2.8
Compile Real Repository Architecture into Structured LLM Prompts.
Deliver pristine, token-optimized context packs directly into Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Gemini.

1. Context & Feature Slice Modes
• Context Mode: Synthesizes overview, module boundaries, and conventions.
• Feature Slice Mode: Extracts target feature plus its exact 2-hop interface closure.
• 85–92% Token Savings: Replaces massive 50k dumps with 3k-token context blueprints.

2. Rebuild Spec & Test Suite Modes
• Rebuild Spec Mode: Generates specifications, schemas, and API contracts.
• Test Suite Mode: Analyzes call hierarchies to construct targeted test suites.
• Contract Assertions: Prompts include AST assertions enforcing strict types.

3. Interactive Compiler UI & CLI
• Modal Selector: Select target nodes, toggle mode, and preview markdown.
• Clipboard Copy: One click copies token-counted blueprint directly to clipboard.
• Headless CLI: Run reposcope prompt --mode feature --target <symbol>.
Slide 09: Four-mode reverse-prompt compiler and 92% token reduction.
09 • REPOSITORY INTELLIGENCE   •   REPOSCOPE v2.8
Universal Assistant: Zero-Hallucination Q&A with AST Citations.
Ask questions about your codebase. Get streaming answers backed by clickable, verified AST citations.

AST-Verified Citation Engine
• Zero-Hallucination Guarantee: Code quotes are checked with .reposcope/graph.json.
• Green Pill Badges: Verified references render with a glowing green badge.
• Interactive Snapping: Clicking citations focuses the node and opens the IDE.

Universal Action Cards
• Embedded UI Cards: Assistant responses include actionable UI buttons.
• [Launch Tour]: One-click action to begin guided architectural walkthrough.
• [Run Security Audit]: Triggers security scan on discussed files instantly.
• [Simulate Blast Radius]: Simulates impact of suggested refactorings.

BYOK Multi-Model Flexibility
• Bring Your Own Key: Connect Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, or OpenAI.
• 100% Local LLM: Route queries to local Ollama / LM Studio endpoints.
• Streaming SSE: Fluid token-by-token delivery with low latency.
Slide 10: Universal chat with green citation pills and dynamic action cards.
10 • PRODUCTIVITY & HEALTH   •   REPOSCOPE v2.8
Executable Scaffolding and Deep Repository Health Telemetry.
Spin up clean architectural starter kits in seconds and identify high-risk co-change hotspots.

Clean Architecture Scaffolder
• Executable Starter Kits: Multi-file scaffolds for FastAPI, React, and Go.
• Hexagonal Clean Patterns: Enforces domain isolation and repository interfaces.
• Interactive Preview: Inspect generated file hierarchies and code in the UI.
• CLI Execution: Copy-paste one-line CLI command to scaffold new modules.

Git Churn & Co-Change Hotspots
• Commit Churn: Analyzes git history (HEAD~10..HEAD) against AST complexity.
• Co-Change Coupling: Discovers hidden temporal dependencies between files.
• Drift Warnings: Warns when frequently changed files gain excessive dependencies.

Engineering Health Metrics
• Bus Factor: Identifies critical modules maintained by single contributors.
• Cycle & Dead Code: Calculates Tarjan SCC cycles and finds unreachable symbols.
• PageRank Hubs: Ranks the top 10 most influential backbone components.
Slide 11: Clean architecture scaffolder and Git churn hotspot metrics.
11 • INTEGRATION & PRIVACY   •   REPOSCOPE v2.8
The Graph Follows Your Editor. 100% Local-First Privacy.
Real-time IDE intelligence without sending a single line of proprietary code to external clouds.

Native VS Code Extension
• Live Status Bar: Real-time dependent count and risk level for active file.
• CodeLens Callers: Click 'View Callers (6)' directly above exported functions.
• Activity Bar Mini-Graph: Renders 2-hop neighborhood around open file.
• Open VSX Registry: Packaged and distributed on Open VSX (adityapatel5912.reposcope).

Zero-Upload Local Privacy
• Localhost Architecture: reposcope run . executes 100% on 127.0.0.1:4100.
• Air-Gapped Compliance: Run safely on sensitive enterprise codebases.
• In-Memory AST Caching: Sub-millisecond graph queries served from local memory.

Browser-Local WASM Engine
• showDirectoryPicker API: Open repository folders in Chrome/Edge directly.
• Tree-sitter WASM: Parses code directly inside the browser sandbox.
• Zero-Install Demos: Test RepoScope instantly on sample repos without terminal.
Slide 12: VS Code extension and local-first zero-upload privacy.

13 • CONCLUSION   •   REPOSCOPE v2.8
Get Started with RepoScope in 30 Seconds.
Turn your codebase into a living, queryable code graph today.

1. Quickstart Install
• pip install reposcope
• reposcope run .
• Or via npm / npx:
  npx @reposcope/cli run .
• Serves on 127.0.0.1:4100 with zero configuration.

2. Connect Your Agents
• reposcope mcp . --apply-all
• Writes verified MCP configs for Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Codex, Windsurf.
• Agents start using 8 graph tools immediately.
